Subject: Project Submission and Clarification on Pearl Sources

Hi [Name],

I noticed that the deadline for the recent project submission was missed. As this is not the first time this has happened, it is important that we discuss this matter urgently to ensure we can meet expectations moving forward. Please let me know when you are available for a brief meeting to address this.

Additionally, per your request, I wanted to clarify that pearls are typically found in mollusks, such as oysters and mussels.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
